newsitem.title: CROATIA: Police seize more cocaine in Croatian port.
newsitem.headline: Police seize more cocaine in Croatian port.

text.p: Police and customs in the Adriatic port of Rijeka on Sunday confiscated 38 kg (85 lb) of cocaine a day after they made the largest-ever drug seizure in Croatia, state television reported.
The cocaine, hidden in a container, was discovered by a police dog.
Police on Saturday found 150 kg (330 lb) of cocaine at the port. The two seizures were worth $10 million, the television report said.
A police spokesman in Rijeka said they were continuing the search.
The cocaine was believed to have come from Ecuador and to be destined for Western European markets.
